indexing.paragraph: Pixlock (the "Game") is a simple puzzle game developed by Xoja Games. This Privacy Policy explains how we handle your information when you use our Game.

Age (for legal compliance only) When you first launch the game, we ask for your age. This is used only on your device to determine whether to enable child-directed or under-age-of-consent ad settings. No age data is stored or sent to our servers.
You do not need to create an account, provide an email address, or submit any other personal data to play our Game.
In addition, our Game uses Google AdMob to display advertisements. AdMob is a third-party service provided by Google LLC that may collect certain data automatically to serve and improve ads.
According to Google's documentation, the Google Mobile Ads SDK may collect the following types of information :
Used to estimate your approximate location
Advertising identifier (AAID on Android, IDFA on iOS)
Device model, operating system version, screen size
App launch time, crash logs, hang rates
Non-user related crash logs to improve SDK performance
Improve the SDK's stability and functionality

When you first launch the game, we may ask you to provide your age. This information is used locally on your device solely to determine whether to enable TagForChildDirectedTreatment or TagForUnderAgeOfConsent in compliance with applicable laws (such as the Children’s Online Privacy Protection Act (COPPA) and the GDPR in the EU). All the other data processing is performed by Google AdMob for advertising purposes. Google may use the collected information to serve personalized or non-personalized ads based on your advertising preferences.
You can learn more about how Google uses data when you use apps that contain AdMob in Google's How Google uses data when you use our partners' sites or apps.
Our Game uses the following third-party service:
We do not share any data with any other third parties. We do not sell your personal information.
You can control how ads are personalized using your device settings:
On Android: Go to Settings → Google → Ads → Opt out of Ads Personalization
On iOS: Go to Settings → Privacy → Apple Advertising → Limit Ad Tracking
You can also visit Google Ad Settings to manage your preferences.

If you wish to request deletion of data collected by AdMob, please contact us at xojagames@gmail.com. We will forward your request to Google in accordance with their processes. You may also revoke consent through the consent management options provided within the Game (if applicable in your region).
All game progress, level completion data, settings, and the age information you provided are stored only on your device using local storage. You can delete this data at any time by:
Clearing the app's data through your device settings

Our Game is a simple puzzle game suitable for all ages. We do not knowingly collect personal information from children under 13. If you are a parent or guardian and believe your child has provided us with personal information, please contact us.
Note for AdMob: Google may serve non-personalized ads to children based on the app's designation in AdMob's settings. We have configured our ad settings accordingly.

No age information is stored on our servers or linked to any persistent identifier. The age selection is only used to configure third-party ad networks and analytics tools to comply with legal requirements for child-directed or age-appropriate treatment. All game data remains on your device. Data collected by AdMob is handled according to Google's security practices.

AdMob is operated by Google LLC, which processes data globally. Your information may be transferred to and stored on servers located outside of your country of residence, including the United States. Google complies with international data transfer frameworks, including the EU-US Data Privacy Framework where applicable.

We may update this Privacy Policy from time to time. If we make material changes, we will notify you by updating the "Last Updated" date at the top of this policy and, where appropriate, by displaying a notice within the Game.
